draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.92, the 173rd-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 18th of 27 at CB. He lasted until pick 211, well after his grade rank (173rd): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 9 passes defended in 2019, 9th of 27 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Minnesota Vikings. 77 career games and 28 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (9 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 9 (96th percentile), season snap share 90.0% (92nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 cornerback who played: 90.0% season snap share against a median of 26.1%, above the norm.
